account_deletion_intro: 1. Before you decide to delete your account, please carefully read the following instructions to ensure you fully understand the consequences of account deletion.
account_deletion_irreversible: 2. Account Deletion is Irreversible: Once you confirm the deletion of your account, your account and related information will be permanently removed and cannot be recovered. Please proceed with caution.
account_deletion_data_erasure:
3. Data Erasure: After account deletion, the following information will be permanently erased and cannot be restored:
- Personal data
- Third-party account information
- Purchase history, including top-up history, episode unlocking history, and My List
- Account balance, including Coins and Bonus Coins
- VIP benefits
account_deletion_vip_subscription: 4. Auto-renewing VIP Subscription: If you have purchased an auto-renewing VIP subscription and your account is currently in VIP status, deleting your account will not cancel the subscription. Please cancel your subscription in the App Store before deleting your account.

recharge_tips: 1.YogoShort offers both free and paid content.
2.Paid content can be unlocked with Coins or Reward Coins, or watched after purchasing a membership.
3.During your subscription, you can watch all content in the app without limits.
4.Subscription benefits will take effect within 24 hours after a successful subscription, depending on the status of your order in the App Store.

5.Within 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period, your account will be charged the renewal fee based on the price of your selected plan. After a successful renewal payment, your subscription period will be extended automatically.
6.To cancel renewal, go to the App Store and cancel your subscription at least 24 hours before the current subscription period ends.
7.Eligibility for some offers depends on the status of your Apple ID. If your Apple ID is not eligible, the offer may be unavailable. The price shown in your order at checkout will apply.
8.If your top-up was completed and payment was deducted successfully but your balance has not changed, tap “Restore” to refresh.
9.If you have any other questions, please contact us via “Feedback.”
By continuing, you agree to our Membership Agreement|Paid Services Agreement|Privacy Policy
